title: Music of Murder
summary: A singer is found shot dead while being brought on stage in a coffin.
method: The victim usually demands to be alone 15 minutes before the performance. The killer set the clock back 10 minutes and shot him. The killer plays a wrong key on stage when he sees that the body was brought on stage, leading DI Poole to put the other pieces together.
motive: The killer is a songwriter for the band and will benefit from royalties because the lead singer is dead. He already prepared the greatest hits album for release.
killer: The bass player in the band
notes: There were a lot of red herrings and misdirection that didn't necessarily add to the plot. The team were searching for a woman with a distinct pair of shoes and found that it's the victim's daughter. The medallion she was wearing led them to discover that she switched out the medallion with the one found on her dad's body but it didn't add anything to the plot.
